observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a Blue Gate UPS.

The actual UPS unit is not shown in the photo.

claims.evidence: The box is shown, but the specific model checkbox is not clearly marked and the unit itself is not visible.
The box mentions 'Internal AVR' which is typical for line-interactive units, but the actual device is not shown.
This specific power rating is not visible on the packaging in the photo.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, older, or damaged model.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual UPS unit out of the box, including the rear specification label.

risks.risk: The internal lead-acid batteries may be dead, leaking, or missing.
risks.proof: A video of the UPS powering a significant load (e.g., a desktop PC or a large fan) while unplugged from the wall.

risks.risk: The unit may have internal electronic faults and fail to charge or switch.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in, charging, and successfully passing a self-test.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual UPS unit out of the box.
Photo of the specification sticker on the back of the UPS unit.
Video of the UPS turned on and powering a load while unplugged from the mains.
response.reason: The brand and model are identified from the retail packaging. The item will be priced at its worst-case scenario (non-functional or empty box) until the actual unit and its condition are verified.
